title: Event ID 4688 process creation — CommandLine field presence by audit GPO state
event_type: Security channel, EventID 4688 (A new process has been created), 'Include command line in process creation events' GPO enabled vs. disabled

fields.label: CommandLine (GPO disabled)
fields.value: (field absent — event contains no command-line data at all)

callouts.explanation: This is the only place the full invoked command — including a suspicious -enc argument — is visible, and it exists solely because the 'Include command line in process creation events' GPO is turned on.
With the GPO off, this exact same process launch produces a 4688 with no command-line data whatsoever — the malicious argument is invisible to anyone relying on native logging alone.
Always present regardless of GPO state, but by itself only tells you powershell.exe ran — not what it was told to do.

note: Conceptual/illustrative side-by-side field breakdown of the same 4688 event with the command-line GPO enabled versus disabled; not a captured screenshot of Event Viewer or any product interface.
